configurations.name: backend-test
runtimeArgs: cd backend && mkdir -p qa/backups && { [ -f qa/platform-qa.db ] || { command -v sqlite3 >/dev/null && sqlite3 src/db/platform.db ".backup 'qa/platform-qa.db'" || cp src/db/platform.db qa/platform-qa.db; }; } && PORT=4001 SJVN_DB_PATH=qa/platform-qa.db SJVN_BACKUP_DIR=qa/backups node src/server.js

configurations.name: backend-multisrc
runtimeArgs: cd backend && mkdir -p qa/backups-multisrc && PORT=4002 SJVN_DB_PATH=qa/platform-qa-multisrc.db SJVN_BACKUP_DIR=qa/backups-multisrc node src/server.js

configurations.name: backend-finale
runtimeArgs: cd backend && mkdir -p qa/backups-finale && { [ -f qa/platform-finale.db ] || sqlite3 src/db/platform.db ".backup 'qa/platform-finale.db'"; } && PORT=4003 SJVN_DB_PATH=qa/platform-finale.db SJVN_BACKUP_DIR=qa/backups-finale node src/server.js

configurations.name: frontend-reia-beta
runtimeArgs: cd frontend && VITE_REIA_BETA=1 VITE_API_TARGET=http://localhost:4010 npx vite --port 5180 --strictPort

configurations.name: backend-reia-beta
runtimeArgs: cd backend && REIA_BETA=1 node --input-type=module -e "const {app}=await import('./src/server.js'); app.listen(4010, () => console.log('REIA beta API on 4010'));"
